name: Charles County, MD
findings: Charles County has 506 nonprofit organizations. 228 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 175 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Charles County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 55 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 26 in similar places of this size.
